case_state_history_states_check.name: case_state_history_states_check
case_state_history_states_check.value:
"base"."case_state_history"."to_state" in ('open', 'negotiating', 'committed', 'frozen', 'supervisor_queue', 'transferred', 'settled')
        and ("base"."case_state_history"."from_state" is null or "base"."case_state_history"."from_state" in ('open', 'negotiating', 'committed', 'frozen', 'supervisor_queue', 'transferred', 'settled'))

invoices_sign_check.name: invoices_sign_check
invoices_sign_check.value:
("base"."invoices"."kind" = 'invoice' and "base"."invoices"."amount_cents" > 0 and "base"."invoices"."balance_cents" between 0 and "base"."invoices"."amount_cents")
        or ("base"."invoices"."kind" = 'credit_note' and "base"."invoices"."amount_cents" < 0 and "base"."invoices"."balance_cents" between "base"."invoices"."amount_cents" and 0)

disputes_close_note_check.name: disputes_close_note_check
disputes_close_note_check.value: ("base"."disputes"."closed_at" is null) = ("base"."disputes"."close_note" is null) and ("base"."disputes"."closed_at" is null) = ("base"."disputes"."closed_by" is null)

contacts_coordinate_check.name: contacts_coordinate_check
contacts_coordinate_check.value: "base"."contacts"."email" is not null or "base"."contacts"."phone" is not null or "base"."contacts"."postal_address" is not null
